g_ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

f_ir.name: loss_contrastive_advantage_reciprocal_sum
f_ir.intuition: Maintain the pairwise contrastive framework combining log-probability differences with inverted advantage gaps, but aggregate pair losses using a sum instead of a mean to emphasize total loss magnitude, useful for unnormalized or weighted batch sizes.
f_ir.pseudocode:
adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
l_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']
inv_adv = 1 / (abs(adv_gap) + epsilon)
score = l_diff * inv_adv
loss_vec = weight * softplus(-score)
loss = sum(loss_vec)
f_ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    epsilon = 1e-6
    abs_adv = ops.add(ops.abs(adv_gap), epsilon)
    inv_adv = ops.div(ops.ones_like(abs_adv), abs_adv)
    l_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    score = ops.mul(l_diff, inv_adv)
    neg_score = ops.neg(score)
    loss_vec = ops.softplus(neg_score)
    if weight is not None:
        loss_vec = ops.mul(loss_vec, weight)
    return ops.sum(loss_vec)
